== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Forging is a technique used to manipulate [[madra]] by giving it physical form and structure. Practitioners can condense their power into various objects, ranging from simple tools like nails, coins, and discs to complex constructs such as weapons, shields, snakes, or even massive stone giants. The density and stability of these creations vary; some Forgers can create [[madra]] so thick it mimics the properties of [[steel]], while others produce brittle illusions that shatter easily or dissipate after a few seconds. Advanced applications allow for the creation of solid illusions, the duplication of weapons through echoes, or even imbuing [[madra]] with temporary life to create autonomous entities like flying swords or [[dragons]]. Forging can also be used for personal utility, such as condensing [[madra]] into [[scales]] to facilitate its consumption for power [[advancement]]. Forging serves as the fundamental skill required for [[Soulsmithing]]. While making basic constructs is considered relatively simple, true [[Soulsmithing]] involves the sophisticated integration of [[madra]] with [[dead matter]] and spiritual [[binding|bindings]] to create functional, safe, and durable items. This process requires a deep understanding of how different [[aspects of madra]] behave—as some may dissolve in light, turn to liquid, or reform when unobserved—and necessitates the use of specialized tools like [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] for handling volatile materials. Successful [[Soulsmithing]] depends heavily on compatibility between the creator's power and the [[construct]], as well as the ability to reshape [[madra]] into precise forms.}}
